The '''Unbreakable engine system''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine produced by [[Celestial Industries]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The engine system allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to transfer of the ship's engine power to the shield power reserves.
